title: VTC Badges — Create — payload
description: Define a badge: a community badge, which creates the badge group that backs it, or a kudos badge a member makes. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

sha256.description: The digest vtc/badges/images/upload answered to this signer.

image.description: The picture, as the signer uploaded it with vtc/badges/images/upload.

repeatable.description: Whether one member may hold the badge more than once. Absent: false for a community badge; a kudos badge is always repeatable and refuses `false`.

requestable.description: Community badges only. Whether members may ask for it (a request to join the badge group). Absent: false.

listed.description: Whether members who do not hold it see it in the badge list. Absent: true.

shareableOutside.description: Community badges only. Whether holders may show it outside the community, which fixes the credential's regime. Absent: false.

holdersVisibleTo.description: Community badges only. Who may see the badge's holders: the badge group's `showMembers`. Absent: `members`.

automatic.description: Community badges only. Present: the badge is automatic, backed by a dynamic badge group computed from `rule`; nobody gives it by hand and `requestable` is refused.

owners.description: Community badges only. Members to appoint as the badge's owners — the badge group's managers — as vtc/groups/managers/add appoints them, bounded by the signer's own holding.

Response.title: VTC Badges — Create — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/badges/create/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/badges/create/0.1#response.

group.description: The badge group, as vtc/groups/create answers it. Present exactly for a community badge.
